Hi Ben,

We signed up via the private deployment form and are interested in a short technical + procurement walkthrough to validate an on-prem pilot. A few details up front:

- Organization: HealthSys (hospital IT)
- Primary use: patient-matching & triage assistant in an air-gapped environment
- Compliance: HIPAA + internal SOC-like controls, will need SOC2 summary and data retention controls
- Preferred weeks: Aug 2–6 or Aug 9–13, mornings (US/Eastern)
- Attendees (tentative): me (SRE lead), Rebecca (procurement)

Can someone from Redwood confirm availability and what evidence you usually need before a demo? Also happy to share a short intake doc if that helps.

Thanks,
Sasha Ramirez
SRE Lead, HealthSys
sasha@healthsys.io

Hi Sasha — thanks for the details and for signing up. Quick note to say we can support an on-prem pilot; we'll want to split the initial engagement into two short sessions to keep things efficient: 30 minutes technical (network, kernel/infra requirements, data flow) + 30 minutes procurement/compliance.

Two asks from our side to help us come prepared:
- Can you confirm the timezone of the attendees (you listed Eastern) and a few concrete windows (we can block mornings ET)
- Could Rebecca or your procurement team share any purchasing timeline or PO rules (net30, vendor setup) so we can bring the right folks?

I've attached our quick intake checklist and a proposed calendar slot file. Priyom will handle the ops preflight (network ports, image distribution) and Vivek will run the technical session if that works.

Proposed slots (all ET):
- Tue Aug 3, 09:30–10:30 (tech + procurement back-to-back)
- Wed Aug 11, 10:00–11:00 (split into two 30-min blocks if preferred)

If those don't work, send two windows and we'll adapt.

Attachments: RDW-Private-intake-checklist.pdf, proposed-calendar.ics

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 650 555 0102
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production

Thanks for the ping — looping in ops and putting a practical plan together.

Ben is correct that splitting the session keeps things crisp. Proposed agenda:
- 09:30–10:00: Technical deep-dive (networking, image/airgap strategy, KV cache persistence, quantization/latency expectations)
- 10:00–10:30: Procurement & security (SOC2 controls we can share, evidence required for an on-prem EULA/license)

Prep items we'll need from HealthSys before the technical session:
1) A simple network diagram or: outbound allowlist for image pull endpoints and NTP (we can provide a minimal list)
2) Whether you require an airgapped installer vs. pull images from a customer-approved registry
3) Point of contact for procurement (Rebecca?) and any mandatory contractual clauses (e.g., data residency, indemnity thresholds)

I attached our SOC2-summary.pdf and a short ops checklist with the ports and image sizes. For scheduling: I can take Tue Aug 3 at 09:30 ET. If that works for Rebecca and Sasha, I'll send a calendar invite and split the event into two adjacent blocks so we can have the right people join the second half.

Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf

—
